captions.text: Ophanim - organization-scoped freight intelligence. Synthetic demo only.
Import an Excel shipment file. Review mapping before any records are created.
The review gate validates columns and duplicates. The operator confirms the import.
DXB-291: Jebel Ali to Nhava Sheva. The stored shipment opens as a real record.
A synthetic weather advisory matches DXB-291 by destination port. Rules decide; operators review.
The operator records a next step and rationale. No carrier booking is changed.
Verify checks public-event claims. These examples are explicitly synthetic replays.
PARTLY TRUE: fog and diversions, but recorded departures contradict a full closure.
Evidence shows sources, observation times and what supports or contradicts the claim.
A public share contains only the claim and evidence, not private organization records.
Signed-in history preserves previous checks. Deterministic verification works without AI.
Ophanim watches the world for your freight. Recorded fixtures, not live intelligence.

limitations: Existing import, shipment, actual port-match, operator decision log and Verify workflows recorded.
This matcher shows a port match, not a validated forecast-cone/time-window engine. The operator note does not change a carrier booking.
Document discrepancy, Gulf signal and confirmation scenes not yet included.
No real customer data, API keys or live provider traffic.
